text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging alert: Smart-routing anomaly detected for rollout canary 'recommend-model-v2' — high error ratio + repeated cross-region fallback loops. Alert ID: IR-2026-0423-009. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd1234/smart-routing

alice: got the page. I'm on it. seeing a spike in 5xxs from us-west-2 -> fallback to eu-central causing latency spikes. :eyes:

bob: Acknowledged. I'm pulling routing logs now.

carla: oncall-sre, are we currently running sticky session-affinity for that route? we just enabled a per-route TTL change in the rollout config last night.

oncall-sre: Yes, the canary rollout set `sessionAffinity: sticky` with `ttl: 3600` for canary traffic.

alice: logs show variant mismatch: traffic pinned to variant v2 in us-west-2 but v2 instances are returning 502 for some prompts. Smart-router continuously falls back to eu-central variants, but affinity stickiness is retaining a dead route after failover causing a loop.

bob: loop details: request -> us-west-2:v2 (502) -> fallback -> eu-central:v1 (200) -> next request due to sticky policy goes back to us-west-2:v2, repeat. TTL prevents rebalancing.

dave: That explains user reports of flakiness + longer p99. How many customers affected?

emily: Quick metric dump: ~3.2% of total generation requests in the last 12m impacted. Top customers: acme-inc (approx 12k reqs), mobiapps (5k). Error budget impact: ~0.6% increase.

ryan_pm: Customer-impact: a few interactive features time out for end-users (autocomplete & code generation). We're starting an incident page for downstream comms.

carla: Immediate mitigation steps: pause canary rollout, disable sticky affinity for the route, or reduce TTL. Which is least-risky?

alice: I'd prefer to pause the canary and evict sticky sessions first. Rolling back variants will affect stateful sessions; disabling sticky should let smart-router rebalance quickly to healthy variants.

oncall-sre: I'll run commands now.

oncall-sre: Running: ```bash
redwoodctl rollout pause --name recommend-model-v2 --env production
redwoodctl routing update --route /v1/recommend --sessionAffinity disabled
```

incident-bot: Action taken: rollout recommend-model-v2 paused by oncall-sre. Routing update submitted.

bob: I see the routing config change propagated. TTL still showing 3600 in cache for some sessions though — need manual eviction from kv-affinity-store.

alice: Evicting sticky entries: ```bash
redwoodctl affinity evict --route /v1/recommend --regions all --confirm
```

alice: Eviction started. Monitoring request paths now.

emily: After eviction, error ratio dropping — p50/p90 latency returning to baseline. Request reroute rate to eu-central down 78%.

dave: Good. What's the root cause for variant v2 returning 502s?

bob: Traces show an unexpected input shape hitting a new kernel path in v2 quantized model; it's failing on long prompt tokenization edge-case. Reproducer attached.

carla: So v2 is buggy. For the short term, we should unpin canary and keep sessionAffinity off. Then rollback model assignment for production->v1. Then resume controlled rollout later after fix.

ryan_pm: Agreed. Also need to notify affected customers and update incident status.

oncall-sre: Rolling back model variant assignment now: ```bash
redwoodctl model set --route /v1/recommend --model recommend-model-v1 --force --reason "emergency rollback: v2 producing 502s"
```

incident-bot: Model set action queued. Expect ~30s to propagate per region.

alice: Propagation ok. Confirming no further cross-region loops.

emily: Customer impact update: estimated 95% of affected requests have returned to normal. We'll draft a postmortem and a customer-facing note.

dave: Handing off to reliability squad for follow-up and root cause fix. oncall-sre, can you stay on until we handoff to eng-runtime?

oncall-sre: Yes, I'll stay for the handoff.

carla: Handoff checklist: incident timeline, traffic graphs, failing input reproducer, model artifact id for v2 (sha: 4f2a9b), rollout config diff, routing policy diff. I'll create a ticket and assign to eng-runtime.

alice: I'll triage reproducer and open a patch pr to guardrail tokenization path.

ryan_pm: We'll prepare a brief customer note: short explanation, what we did (paused canary, evicted sticky sessions, rolled back to v1), and a timeline.

incident-bot: Pager duty: incident acknowledged by alice at 1745010100. Severity: Sev2. Incident channel created: #incident-recommend-v2-1745009999

bob: One follow-up: add an automated check to the rollout pipeline that runs long-tokenization fuzz tests against quantized kernels before enabling sticky affinity.

carla: Agreed — adding to the postmortem action items.

emily: Estimated mitigation complete. I'll send the customer triage to comms and ops.

dave: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll mark this incident as mitigated and hand off for RCA and postmortem. :white_check_mark:

oncall-sre: No objections. Leaving channel but reachable.

alice: leaving oncall to eng-runtime for fix; will follow up on PR.

ryan_pm: I'll coordinate the customer message once postmortem has initial draft.

incident-bot: Incident IR-2026-0423-009 status: Mitigated -> Handed off. Logs archived: s3://incidents/2026/0423/1745009999.zip
